# First Real-Data Workflow — authored synthetic input

All sequences, annotation, identities and genotype here are independently authored
software fixtures under the package license. They are not GRCh38, GENCODE, MANE,
patient observations or experimentally measured HLA/immune data. Assembly/release
labels merely satisfy the same format/identity contracts as real inputs.

The normal molecular reconstruction route processes one missense SNV (AAG to
GAG, protein K30E) in a 61-aa precursor. A second two-aa catalog-only protein and
transcript provide explicit Sec metadata; they have no variant or genomic model.
Class I 8:12 and Class II 15 are explicit tutorial settings. No predictor is
configured, no binding scores are supplied and no observed read counts/VAF are
invented. The helper obtains HLA solely from declared fictional examples.

These files are supplied explicitly to the installed example, never selected as
the default human resource bundle. Replace all fixture paths and declarations
with genuine compatible resources before analyzing real VCFs. Never mix them.
